name: Knott's Boysenberry Festival Guide: Boysenberry Elote/Meatballs/Sausage Warning vs. Safe Roasted Meats & Soft-Serve
brandOrRestaurant: Knott's Boysenberry Festival Tasting Card Booths (Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: If using a Boysenberry Festival Tasting Card in spring, spend your tabs on smooth-sauced proteins and starches (like Pulled Pork/Beef over Mashed Potatoes, Polenta/Grits, Pasta, or Boysenberry Soft-Serve/Smoothies) rather than whole-kernel elote corn, spicy habanero wings, or seed-heavy cobblers.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Use your Tasting Card tabs on braised beef/pork over mashed potatoes, turkey sliders, cheese ravioli/mac & cheese (with lactase), and smooth boysenberry icee/soft-serve—skip Boysenberry Elote Corn on the Cob and Habanero/Chipotle items.
watchOuts: Avoid Boysenberry Elote (whole corn hulls + chili-lime), Boysenberry Chili, and whole-berry cobblers
